They were seen on an island with [[Xerosic]] and some {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s, conducting an experiment with a prototype weapon utilizing some {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Cells}} and the [[Mega Evolution]] energy previously collected by Team Flare. In ''[[XY111|Unlocking Some Respect!]]'', Admins helped Xerosic with experimenting on [[Z2]]. In ''[[XY119|A Full-Strength Battle Surprise!]]'', Admins used a machine to create some giant roots in a forest that an [[Officer Jenny]] came to investigate. A male Admin appeared in ''[[XY129|Kalos League Passion with a Certain Flare!]]'' and ''[[XY130|Finals Not for the Faint-Hearted!]]'', where he was seen with Lysandre and later with Lysandre and [[Mairin]], as they all were in a private box in the [[Lumiose Conference]] stadium watching the final battle between {{Ash}} and [[Alain]]. In ''[[XY131|Down to the Fiery Finish!]]'', Admins used a machine that altered Z2's mind so that it would listen to Team Flare. A male Admin appeared in ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', where he led Alain to Xerosic in the Prism Tower. Multiple Admins appeared in ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]''. ====Voice actors==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{vatable |en=[[List of English voice actors|Alyse Lamb]] ([[XY106]])

Alexandre Drummond (male) }} ===Pokémon Evolutions=== [[File:Team Flare Admin Evolutions.png|thumb|250px|A Team Flare Admin in [[Pokémon Evolutions]]]] Some Team Flare Admins made a brief appearance in ''[[PE03|The Visionary]]'', helping to evacuate the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]] as [[Lysandre]] activated the [[ultimate weapon]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Team Flare Admin F Adventures.png|thumb|200px|A female Team Flare Admin in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Chalmers Adventures.png|thumb|200px|[[Chalmers]], a male Team Flare Admin, in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== {{adv|Tierno}} encountered a female Team Flare Admin at {{rt|5|Kalos}}. After learning of her plans to lead an operation to rob the [[Poké Ball Factory]], Tierno fought the Admin to stop her. With help from X, Tierno managed to defeat the Admin, though they were unable to prevent the Poké Ball Factory from being robbed later. A male Team Flare Admin named [[Chalmers]] attacked Gurkinn to obtain the secrets of [[Mega Evolution]] for his superiors, but was defeated by [[Diantha]]. He was later seen locking {{kal|Grace}} in her cell after her failed escape attempt. Chalmers, a female Admin, and [[Malva's Delphox]] planned to drain Pokémon [[Death in the Pokémon world#Life-force|life energy]] on {{rt|10|Kalos}} for the [[ultimate weapon]], but were thwarted by [[Alexa]], [[Viola]], [[Clemont]], [[Bonnie]], and [[Yvette]]. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Team Flare |pkmn=Flygon |type1=Ground |type2=Dragon |img=Team Flare Admin Flygon Adventures.png |epnum=PS564 |epname=Corphish Pinches |desc={{p|Flygon}} was used by a female Team Flare Admin {{adv|X}} and his friend encountered at {{rt|5|Kalos}}.
